hooks.text: 八名赏金猎人各带专属武器、绝招与截然不同的战斗套路
hooks.excerpt: Eight playable hunters, Eight deadly playstyle. From Kyle’s trickshot gunplay, Diddo’s chaotic worm swarms, Rudy’s Plasma Burst, Dhala’s spirit spear, Xane’s lightning-fast claw attacks, Gorogozo’s brutal Mega Slash, Kingka’s minigun mayhem, to Jaz’s rhythm-powered rocket launcher — every hunter brings unique weapons, Specials, and combat styles to the hunt.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 套索不仅跨越地形，还能操纵环境并重创失衡敌人
hooks.excerpt: Signature Lasso Mechanics: Grapple across gaps, manipulate the environment, and deal massive damage to staggered enemies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Boss倒下后合作立刻终止，队友互斗只争一顶蠢王冠
hooks.excerpt: Final Showdown: Boss goes down, friendships go out the window. One winner. No bonus loot. Just a stupid crown and the eternal right to call everyone else the clown. Because you're the crowned clown now.
